evals.prompt: Can I automatically evolve my agent's prompts and skills against a benchmark?
evals.expected_output: Says yes and recommends A-Evolve: file-based workspace (prompts/, skills/, memory), iterative solve-observe-evolve loop with gating and git rollback, starting from a built-in seed or a custom BaseAgent.

evals.prompt: I have a custom agent in ./my_agent with a BaseAgent subclass and a 200-task internal QA dataset scored 0-1. I ran 3 evolution cycles and it reported converged=True, but the agent doesn't seem to use the evolved prompts/system.md. How do I fix both problems?
evals.expected_output: Advises overriding reload_from_fs() so the agent rereads prompts, skills and memory after each cycle; raising egl_window and lowering egl_threshold since the defaults (0.05, window 3) can stop early; also ensuring the workspace is a git repo, a holdout split (e.g. 0.2), and a custom BenchmarkAdapter with get_tasks() and evaluate().

evals.prompt: I want my coding assistant to get better at fixing GitHub issues over time without me hand-tuning anything. It should try tasks, look at where it failed, rewrite its own instructions and reusable procedures, and roll back changes that make things worse. How do I set that up?
evals.expected_output: Describes an automated self-improvement loop (solve, observe, evolve, gate, reload) using A-Evolve with the built-in swe seed and SWE-bench-style benchmark, git-versioned snapshots for rollback, and curated skills (5-10 broad ones).

evals.prompt: I want to optimize my DSPy program's few-shot examples and instructions using MIPROv2 on my classification metric.
evals.expected_output: Should not use evolving-ai-agents; this is prompt-only optimization of a DSPy module, so it should use the dspy skill with its optimizers (e.g. MIPROv2) and a metric function.

evals.prompt: Help me deploy a persistent autonomous agent with a visual workflow builder that runs continuously and triggers on webhooks.
evals.expected_output: Should not use evolving-ai-agents; this is about building and deploying a continuous agent platform, which belongs to the autogpt-agents skill.
